title: My 10 days progress. You play a dad trying to keep his daughter alive after the world ended in a single day. You have the choice to farm and trade, loot and kill, share or hurt for clean water. Tools: Opus 5.5, Gemini, Blender, Mixamo
author: Fluffy-Discussion166

comments.author: North-Bird-1325
comments.body:
Solid for 10 days. The "Potatoes take about two days" line is a nice touch, it makes farming feel like a real tradeoff against just looting.

Does the daughter react to how you got the water? If she notices when you hurt someone for it, the share-or-hurt choice would hit a lot harder.

replies.author: Fluffy-Discussion166
replies.body:
Yeap. clean water is really rare. only 3 unit of water everyday in your frontyard. so the early game is all about spending water on the right thing, because the game end when you and daughter die of thirst. 

she won't notice, but there will be some NPC that will force player make tough choice for water.

replies.author: Fluffy-Discussion166
replies.body: any ideas to make this more fun?

comments.author: horsewitnoname
comments.body: Reminds me of project zomboid. Which is a good thing!
